title: AMR analytics
purpose: Explore descriptive resistance patterns from validated local records with transparent filters and denominators.
noLabMessage: Analytics require an explicit laboratory denominator.
noLabHelp: Choose a laboratory before calculating resistance summaries.
capBody: The following catalogues reached 10,000 entries and may be truncated: {{names}}.
cohortDescription: Filters are applied to the active laboratory before denominators and percentages are calculated.

modes.unitAntibiogramHelp: Resistance patterns stratified by ward or location.
modes.priorityIndicatorsHelp: Configured organisms and priority resistance markers.
modes.dataQualityHelp: Completeness, duplicates and potential contamination signals.
modes.isolateListingHelp: Line listing for authorised local review.
modes.clusterWatchHelp: WHONET-compatible prospective or retrospective space-time permutation scan with Monte Carlo significance.

macro.label: Saved analysis macro
macro.modalDescription: The current mode, period and filter selection are stored under this name for the active laboratory.
macro.namePlaceholder: e.g. Urinary E. coli, last 12 months

emptyMessage: Adjust the dates or filters, or validate more isolate records before analysis.

charts.interpretationDescription: Distribution across all AST interpretations in the filtered cohort.
charts.monthlyDescription: Included isolate records by specimen month.
charts.organismsDescription: Most frequent identified organisms in this cohort.
charts.specimensDescription: Composition of the filtered cohort by specimen category.

byAntibiotic.title: Resistance by antibiotic
byAntibiotic.description: Tested denominator is shown for every antibiotic; small denominators require cautious interpretation.
byAntibiotic.emptyMessage: The cohort has isolate records but no matching AST result rows.

quality.title: Data-quality indicators
quality.description: Counts requiring review before formal reporting.

outbreak.reviewGateTitle: Signal is not a confirmed outbreak
outbreak.reviewGateBody: Statistical alerts require infection-prevention review of microbiology, patient overlap, sampling changes, contamination and epidemiological links before action or external reporting.
outbreak.methodHint: Expected counts condition on spatial and temporal marginals with day-of-week stratification. P-values use the maximum statistic across all tested windows, locations and signals.

summaryDescription: Mode-specific observations generated from deterministic local analysis.
clusterDescription: Multiplicity-adjusted statistical signals. Alert status means recurrence interval meets configured threshold; it does not confirm transmission.

help.descriptive: These are descriptive local summaries, not causal estimates. Resistance percentage uses available AST interpretations in the filtered cohort; inspect tested denominators before comparing antibiotics or sites.
help.inclusionBody: The analysis service applies laboratory and date filters, then optional organism, specimen, location and antibiotic filters. Export the same cohort from Standards export for reproducibility.
